values.note: Jackson County residents: power & water $20 a night, full hookups $25, primitive $17; non-residents $25 / $30 / $22. Weekly: residents $120 / $150 / $102, non-residents $150 / $180 / $132. Group sites $28 on request (max 20 people). Reservations need 50% paid up front; a cancellation more than 24 hours out costs one night.

note: Jackson County Parks & Rec campground on Lake Glenville: 6 full-hookup and 18 power-and-water sites (50-amp per the original sweep source) plus primitive and group sites; playground and picnic shelter. --Claude
